# GWinVrbs89

Named action/condition handler over GenWinConfigC89. It can be used directly by an engine or imported into a DSL/verb registry.

Actions: window/window_size, window_mode, window_center, window_position, window_title, window_resizable, window_decorated, window_visible, window_topmost, window_monitor, window_create, window_destroy, window_refresh, window_apply.

Conditions: window_is_fullscreen, window_is_windowed, window_is_borderless, window_is_created, window_is_visible, window_is_resizable, window_is_decorated, window_is_topmost.

Protocol89: ISO C89, no heap, no float/double, no explicit 64-bit types.
